node.statement: In node 1, the phrase compatible amplified rectangular pair is an explicit abbreviation for the following data: an extended epsilon-C*-algebra calA; an integer n >= 1; delta-projections P,Q,R in calA; P_n=I_n tensor P, Q_n=I_n tensor Q, and R_n=I_n tensor R; elements A in S_{P_n,Q_n} and B in S_{Q_n,R_n}; and the compressed product A dot B defined, as in def-compressed-corner applied inside M_n tensor calA, by A dot B=Co_{P_n,R_n}(AB). Thus the quantifier every compatible amplified rectangular pair in node 1 ranges over exactly these data and no others.
